title: Wailea golf course redevelopment of about 900 homes
summary: On October 7, a testifier asked the County to study infrastructure, safety and costs before approving a golf course redevelopment of about 900 homes, noting about 8,000 more homes are projected in South Maui and that open space would be lost. Earlier, a golf representative said 225 acres could hold 600 to 1,000 homes with no number set, and promised 30% in excess of the requirement. The golf representative and the community association president agreed to work together on traffic.
